name: berkshire-team
description: Bilingual company research, independent evidence, bull/bear debate and review. / 双语公司研究、独立取证、多空辩论与复核。

interface.displayName: AI 伯克希尔 · 完整投研团队
interface.shortDescription: 公司研究、多空辩论与独立复核
interface.longDescription: 完整研究由负责人调度四位研究员、两位多空辩手和一位独立复核员。中英文共用流程，面板记录进度，LangGraph 负责交接质询、补证和定向复审。 Full research uses four researchers, two debaters and an independent reviewer. English and Chinese follow the same workflow with a progress panel and LangGraph debate orchestration.
defaultPrompt: 使用 $berkshire-team 以伯克希尔＋AIVA联合模式研究我指定的公司，估值阶段按需调用已链接工具并遵守我的报告顺序；没有公司名时先询问。
Use $berkshire-team to research my chosen company in English using the joint Berkshire and AIVA workflow. Ask for the company if I haven’t named one.
